remarks: Fully remodelled, turnkey 3-bedroom, 2-bath single-family home in Anaheim with no HOA, about 6 minutes from Disneyland. This bright home offers 1,228 sq ft of living space on a 6,360 sq ft lot. The open-concept layout connects the living room, kitchen, and formal dining area, with recessed lighting, new luxury vinyl plank flooring, fresh paint, and natural light throughout. The kitchen features Taj Mahal quartzite counters, a large island with double waterfall edges, new two-tone wood and white cabinets, and new GE gas oven, dishwasher, refrigerator and microwave.
